hotspots.title: Turning Point USA Campus Cane Attack Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Conservative news outlets are expressing widespread outrage over an incident at the University of Texas at Tyler, where a man wearing a cape and wizard hat allegedly attacked Turning Point USA members with a cane. Right-wing media frame the assault as part of a rising wave of leftist violence and systematic campus hostility targeting young conservative activists.
hotspots.affect: Outrage-coded framing of political violence against conservative students fuels intense victimhood narratives and culture-war mobilization.

hotspots.title: Brazilian Prosecutor Seeks Rejection of Bolsonaro Annulment
hotspots.blurb: Brazil's Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet formally requested that the Supreme Federal Court (STF) reject Jair Bolsonaro’s latest petition to annul his 27-year prison sentence related to the 2022 coup plot. The ruling has sparked intense coverage across Bolsonarista channels, which frame the prosecutor's move as continued judicial persecution against the former president.
hotspots.affect: High existential stakes surrounding Bolsonaro's 27-year sentence drive intense partisan grievance and systemic mistrust of the judiciary.

hotspots.title: Italy Mass School Bomb Threats & Meloni Summit
hotspots.blurb: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni convened opposition leaders following coordinated bomb hoaxes targeting over 6,000 Italian schools, urging political unity against democratic destabilization. The summit triggered sharp political clashes, with opposition parties accusing Meloni of seeking 'blank checks' and using national security concerns to muzzle dissent.
hotspots.affect: Widespread panic over threat to schools combined with fierce political battles over state security authority drives elevated emotional investment.

hotspots.title: Howard Lutnick Nvidia Export Probe & Firing Crisis
hotspots.blurb: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces growing pressure and speculation over his potential dismissal as congressional probes expand into Nvidia chip export approvals to China. Right-wing and mainstream outlets highlight internal Republican infighting, labeling Lutnick a potential fall guy in a widening national security spy scandal.
hotspots.affect: Intra-party knife-fighting and espionage allegations generate strong affective engagement focused on administration instability and betrayal.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Santiago Abascal's Vox party launched its campaign for the November 29 Spanish general election around core themes of 'national priority,' strict remigration, and capping immigrant children in public schools. The party's calls to 'save Spain' and oust Pedro Sánchez have polarized election coverage and reignited national debates on migration.
hotspots.affect: Nativist policy proposals and urgent calls for national salvation create high moral charge and ideological polarization ahead of polling day.
